svg.title: All intermediate stops on the selected outbound routes
svg.desc: One connected schematic, not to scale. Read down each line in travel order. Hollow circles are stops; larger rings are boarding, transfer or alighting points. The corridor 4 leg uses Galunggung via Saharjo; 5M uses the via Cikini pattern. Other patterns may skip stops.
svg.text: Outbound routes only · schematic, not to scale · pinch to zoom and drag to pan
Operator GTFS checked 18 Nov 2026. Route patterns and temporary stops can change.
Change platform inside the same paid halte
temporary stop · toward Galunggung via Saharjo
Walk ~2 min to the curbside 7E stop
via Cikini pattern; other 5M patterns differ
Rings = boarding / transfer / get off · small circles = intermediate stops · dashed = walk
Only the travel direction shown is covered. Do not reverse this diagram for the return trip.
7E return-direction stops Phe Tower Kebagusan and Baung are in the destination closeup, not this outbound line.
Check the TJ: Transjakarta app and the vehicle headsign before boarding. No live arrival information.
Passed Jln. Gabus Raya on the 7E? Turn around at Flyover Raya Bogor - card with the Arkadia Green Park route (vanipy.com/tuju/).
